features.title: Unstoppable fury
features.text: Rage fuels heavy weapon hits and grants temporary hit points. It limits concentration, but no longer reduces Armor Class by itself.

features.title: Follow your instinct
features.text: Your instinct shapes your powers and tactics. Choose between a direct damage routine and feats that add movement, maneuvers or supernatural abilities.
